module_summary: In-game EE core (ee_core, upstream Open PS2 Loader derived) pieces: crt0.S is the core's startup (bss cleared once, SetupThread/SetupHeap, main); asm.S holds the syscall hooks that run on ee_core's own stack (SifSetDma/SifSetReg IOP-reboot trap, ExecPS2/CreateThread pad hook, Exit) and the register-clearing ExecPS2 trampoline. cheat_engine.S/cheat_api.c are the PS2RD cheat engine (SetupThread hook, code handler, and the in-game menu's live code-set swap); gsm_api.c/dve_reg.S drive the GS mode selector and its observe-only tracker for the in-game menu/RA. cd_igr_rpc.c sends the IGR shutdown RPC. The freeze_diag*.c files exist only in the ingamediag configuration: freeze_diag.c collects the report, freeze_diag_screen.c draws it on the TV from ee_core, and freeze_diag_format.c is the text formatter compiled into the IOP module freezediag.irx (and host tests), not into ee_core.

reusable_helpers.name: oplIGRShutdown
reusable_helpers.what: binds the IGR RPC server 0x80000598 and sends the shutdown/power-off request

reusable_helpers.name: ee_ticks / budget_spent
reusable_helpers.what: COP0 Count read and a millisecond deadline check on it

reusable_helpers.name: put_dec / put_hex
reusable_helpers.what: printf-free unsigned decimal and 0x%08X writers into a bounded char buffer

reusable_helpers.name: elapsed_ms
reusable_helpers.what: hi/lo split IOP clock difference to milliseconds with 32-bit arithmetic only

reusable_helpers.name: ln_dec / ln_hex
reusable_helpers.what: bounded decimal and variable-width hex appenders for a fixed text line

reusable_helpers.name: fds_wait_ms
reusable_helpers.what: busy-wait N milliseconds on COP0 Count

reusable_helpers.name: fds_send_band
reusable_helpers.what: uploads a band of 32-bit pixels to GS local memory through GIF PATH3 DMA with a bounded wait

reusable_helpers.name: fds_power_pending
reusable_helpers.what: reads and cancels the latched CDVD power-off request in kernel mode

reusable_helpers.name: LinkImage
reusable_helpers.what: applies a bounded [offset,count,words] patch image to EE memory

reusable_helpers.name: InitRegsExecPS2
reusable_helpers.what: clears every GPR/FPR/HI/LO/SA (except a0-a3, ra) and resets sp before ExecPS2

reusable_helpers.name: dve_set_reg / dve_get_reg
reusable_helpers.what: read/write a DVE register over the DEV9 bus

findings.title: GSM 'fix' toggles are compile-time constants written at runtime; the engine tests them on every trapped GS write
findings.problem: UpdateGSMParams is the only writer of GSMFlags and always stores the same values: ADAPTATION/SMODE2/DISPFB/DISPLAY_fix = 1, PMODE/SMODE1/SRFSH/SYNCH/SYNCV_fix = 0. GSHandler still loads and branches on each flag per trapped write, so the PMODE/SMODE1/SRFSH/SYNCH1/SYNCH2/SYNCV 'forced' paths and the five 'fix disabled' paths are unreachable. Side effect: GSMDestGSRegs.syncv (gsm_api.c:104, plumbed from the launcher) is only read at gsm_engine_adv.S:418, behind SYNCV_fix=0, so it never takes effect.
findings.fix: Delete the nine constant flag bytes and their assignments; in the engine keep only the path each constant selects (pass-through store for PMODE/SMODE1/SRFSH/SYNCH1/SYNCH2/SYNCV, forced/adapted path for SMODE2/DISPFB/DISPLAY/adaptation). Drop the syncv store and its parameter if nothing else needs it. Keep FIELD_fix, gs576P_param and track_only (set from config). Upstream GSM (doctorxyz) code: a trim, not a rewrite.
findings.benefit: ~55 source lines; INFERRED ~45 instructions (~180 bytes) of ee_core ram84 text: 6 handlers x ~6 dead instructions + 5 sites x 3 flag-test instructions; one lb+beql less per trapped GS write
findings.evidence: Grep GSMFlags|_fix over ee_core: C writers only gsm_api.c:109-119 (constants, FIELD_fix/gs576P from args); asm readers gsm_engine.S:596,624,678,697,715,937 and gsm_engine_adv.S:307,345,369,390,415 (lb + beql). Offsets gsm_defines.h:76-85. Target_SYNCV/PMODE/SMODE1/SRFSH/SYNCH1/SYNCH2 read only at gsm_engine.S:599 and adv 310,348,372,393,418, each behind a 0-valued flag. gsm_engine_adv.S is #included unconditionally at gsm_engine.S:1260; gsm_engine.S is in ps2.yaml:606.

findings.title: CheatLiveFits only forwards to the header inline igrCheatsFit, and costs an igrovl API slot
findings.problem: CheatLiveFits(b, at) is 'return igrCheatsFit(b, at)'. igrCheatsFit is a static inline in igrcheats.h that reads only the cheat block passed in (no ee_core state), and igrmenu.c already includes igrcheats.h (igrmenu.c:49). Its only caller (igrmenu.c:1028) could call igrCheatsFit directly in both the in-core and overlay builds; the wrapper exists only to be exported through igrovl_api_t.
findings.fix: Delete CheatLiveFits, its prototype, the igrovl_api_t member, the igrovl_side.h macro and the igrovl_stub.c table entry; call igrCheatsFit at igrmenu.c:1028. Bump IGROVL_ABI since the struct layout changes.
findings.benefit: 8 lines; INFERRED a few dozen bytes of ee_core ram84 text (the out-of-line copy of the igrCheatsFit loop) plus one 4-byte API table word in IGR_OVERLAY builds
findings.evidence: Grep -w CheatLiveFits over the whole repo: cheat_api.c:181 (def), cheat_api.h:15, igrovl.h:34, igrovl_side.h:20, igrovl_stub.c:34, igrmenu.c:1028 (only call), comment cheat_api.c:167; none in .github, tests, docs. igrcheats.h:74-83 body uses only b and at.

findings.title: EnableGSTracker/DisableGSTracker repeat EnableGSM/DisableGSM except one flag
findings.problem: EnableGSTracker is EnableGSM with track_only = 1 instead of 0. DisableGSTracker is DisableGSM plus 'track_only = 0', which is redundant because both enable functions set track_only before installing the hooks. Callers: main.c:140,145,151 and padhook.c:588,592,596.
findings.fix: Make one EnableGSM(int track_only) and delete EnableGSTracker; delete DisableGSTracker and call DisableGSM at padhook.c:592 and 596.
findings.benefit: ~12 lines; INFERRED ~40 bytes of ram84 text (two small non-static functions merged)
findings.evidence: Read gsm_api.c:196-245. Grep EnableGSTracker|DisableGSTracker|EnableGSM|DisableGSM in ee_core: main.c:140,145,151; padhook.c:588,592,596; gsm_api.h:17-20; test stubs in .github/scripts/test_igr_polling.py:352 only stub DisableGSM. GSMFlags.track_only is read by gsm_engine.S only after Install_* runs, and every Install path sets it first.

findings.title: crt0.S calls weak _init/_fini that ee_core never defines, and stores/reloads the exit code around them
findings.problem: ee_core is linked with -nostartfiles -nostdlib (ps2.yaml:613), is all C (no constructors/destructors anywhere in ee_core), and no ee_core source defines _init or _fini, so both weak symbols resolve to 0 and the ctors/dtors blocks always branch past. _retval exists only to keep the exit code across the _fini call.
findings.fix: Delete the .weak _init/_fini declarations, the ctors and dtors blocks and _retval; _exit becomes 'Exit(retval)' directly (a0 already holds it).
findings.benefit: ~25 lines; INFERRED 16 instructions (64 bytes) of ram84 text and 4 bytes .bss: 2x(la=2 + beqz/nop/jalr/nop) + 2x(la+sw/lw)
findings.evidence: Grep -w '_init|_fini' over ee_core: only crt0.S:14-18,88,120 and linkfile KEEP(*(.init))/(.fini) lines 34-35; grep constructor|destructor in ee_core: only the linkfile comment. eecore libs are patches, kernel, gcc (ps2.yaml:610) with -nostartfiles -nostdlib; INFERRED that none of those libraries defines _init/_fini (not checked inside the SDK archives). evidence/RiptOPL/raw/eecore-per-object.tsv: crt0.o text 288.

findings.title: Dead declarations and a no-op return-address save in ee_core assembly (asm.S, cheat_engine.S, crt0.S, dve_reg.h)
findings.problem: asm.S declares .extern memset/memcpy/strlen/strncpy/g_argc/g_argv/Install_IGR that it never uses (g_argc/g_argv exist nowhere) and .globl g_argbuf, which has no label anywhere. cheat_engine.S keeps PS2RD ERL leftovers: F_* defines nobody tests, the 'exported when built as ERL' comment, .globl j_SetupThread with no label, an unused eh_jal label, and engine_info (no reader; its .rodata is already discarded). crt0.S declares _isInit (the code uses isInit). dve_get_reg's C prototype has no C caller. HookSetupThread saves and restores ra around code that makes no call.
findings.fix: Delete those lines; in HookSetupThread delete the sp adjust and the ra sd/ld (lines 570-571, 608-609).
findings.benefit: ~30 lines; engine_info .rodata (4 B) already dropped by gc-sections (MEASURED, eecore-discarded-firstparty.txt:9); ra save removal saves 4 instructions = 16 bytes ram84 text (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep -w over the whole repo: g_argbuf/g_argc/g_argv only asm.S:44-45,66; Install_IGR not referenced in asm.S beyond :64; memset|memcpy|strlen|strncpy not used in asm.S body; F_EngineHandler|F_CodeHandler|F_HookSetupThread|j_SetupThread|engine_info|eh_jal only their cheat_engine.S lines; _isInit only crt0.S:23 (main.c:23 defines isInit); dve_get_reg called only in dve_reg.S:62,67. HookSetupThread (568-615) contains no jal/jalr. evidence/RiptOPL/raw/eecore-discarded-firstparty.txt:9 lists 4 bytes .rodata of cheat_engine.o.

findings.title: COP0 Count reader and the 294.912 MHz tick constant are copied in five ee_core files
findings.problem: ee_ticks, fds_ticks, igrmCount, mbCount and ra_ticks are the same 'mfc0 %0, $9' static inline under five names, padhook.c inlines the asm twice more, and the clock constant appears four times (EE_TICKS_PER_MS twice in the two freeze_diag files that are always built together, IGRM_SECOND, MB_SECOND, IGR_SECOND).
findings.fix: Put one static inline count reader and one ticks-per-second constant in an ee_core header every user already includes (for example util.h or ee_core.h; it must stay header-only because igrmenu.c/igrmbox.c are also built into igrovl.elf), and delete the copies.
findings.benefit: ~30 source lines net; no ELF change (all copies are static inline, INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep 'mfc0 %0, \$9|294912' over ee_core: freeze_diag.c:37,57; freeze_diag_screen.c:268,273; igrmenu.c:698,704; igrmbox.c:24,39; padhook.c:126,197,201; ra.c:58. Read each copy: identical asm, return u32. build_configuration.py:68 adds freeze_diag.c and freeze_diag_screen.c together; build_edition.py:161 builds igrmenu.c/igrmbox.c into igrovl.

findings.title: Freeze report has two hand-written formatter sets (put_* for the card file, ln_* for the TV page) and the overrun threshold twice
findings.problem: freeze_diag_screen.c re-implements put_str/put_dec/put_hex/put_where of freeze_diag_format.c as ln_str/ln_dec/ln_hex/ln_where (same digit loop, same module-name+offset search, only the buffer struct and the hex width differ). HEAP_DIAG_OVERRUN_MIN (format.c:325) and FDS_OVERRUN_MIN (screen.h:15) are the same 64-byte rule, whose comment says they must agree. The two files go into different binaries (freezediag.irx and ee_core), so the saving is source only.
findings.fix: Move the buffer helpers (with a hex width argument, 0 = minimal, no prefix) and one overrun constant into a header-only freeze_diag_report.h section used by both files; delete the ln_* copies and the second constant. Both host tests (ee_core/tests) cover the result.
findings.benefit: ~40 source lines net; no binary change in either ELF/IRX (INFERRED: each binary keeps one copy)
findings.evidence: Read format.c:16-57,303-325 and screen.c:36-94 side by side. build_configuration.py:68 compiles freeze_diag_screen.c into eecore, :72 compiles freeze_diag_format.c into the freezediag IOP target. Grep HEAP_DIAG_OVERRUN_MIN|FDS_OVERRUN_MIN: format.c:325,401; screen.h:15; screen.c:215.

findings.title: cheat_api.c: two impossible bounds checks in LinkImage and single-use inline wrappers around SetSyscall
findings.problem: In LinkImage, p is gImage+1 at line 50 and gImage+2 at line 55 while pEnd is gImage+MAX_IMAGEWORDS (1024, cheat_engine.h:30), so both checks are always false; the checks at 59, 62 and 66 are the ones that bound the walk. Install_HookSetupThread and Remove_HookSetupThread are one-caller inline wrappers of one or two statements each, with banner comments.
findings.fix: Delete the checks at lines 50-51 and 55-56; put the wrapper bodies directly into EnableCheats and DisableCheats and delete the wrappers.
findings.benefit: ~16 lines; INFERRED 2 compare+branch pairs (~16 bytes) of ram84 text; wrappers are inlined already, no change
findings.evidence: Read cheat_api.c:40-157; MAX_IMAGEWORDS = 1024 at ee_core/include/cheat_engine.h:30. Grep Install_HookSetupThread|Remove_HookSetupThread: only cheat_api.c:125,134,147,156.

findings.title: freeze_diag.c: fetch_iop's return value is ignored and the IGR RPC id literal is duplicated
findings.problem: fetch_iop returns 1/0 but its only caller (line 239) discards it and tests report.iop_status instead. The IGR RPC server id 0x80000598 is written as IGR_RPC_SERVER in freeze_diag.c and as a bare literal in cd_igr_rpc.c, although freeze_diag.c already includes cd_igr_rpc.h.
findings.fix: Make fetch_iop void (drop the return statements' values and the 'Returns' sentence); define the server id once in cd_igr_rpc.h and use it in both files.
findings.benefit: ~3 lines, trivial; no measurable size change
findings.evidence: Grep -w fetch_iop: freeze_diag.c:156 (def), :239 (call, result unused). Grep 0x80000598 in ee_core: freeze_diag.c:26, cd_igr_rpc.c:15. freeze_diag.c:20 includes cd_igr_rpc.h (one-line header).
